title: dorycnium herbaceum var. decumbens
intro: Dorycnium herbaceum var. decumbens, commonly known as Bitter Milkwort, is a perennial herb belonging to the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Bitter Milkwort include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
